evidence: The Utilities use their systems and infrastructure to create, collect, store, and process sensitive information, including personal information regarding customers, employees and their dependents

The Utilities also plan to start to use artificial intelligence and machine learning to test predictive analytics and control through edge computing to help assess the state of health of utility assets and prevent premature failure

information systems, networks and other technologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning, which are interconnected with the systems and network infrastructure owned by third parties to support a variety of business processes and activities
ai_positioning.summary: HE intègre l'IA et le machine learning en interne pour optimiser ses opérations de distribution électrique, notamment via des analyses prédictives et le monitoring des actifs. L'IA est utilisée comme outil opérationnel pour améliorer la fiabilité du réseau et prévenir les défaillances.
